title: How to Plan a Trip to Tanzania, Step by Step
excerpt: From choosing a season to booking flights: a step-by-step plan for your trip to Tanzania.
body:
## 1. What do you want?

Safari, Kilimanjaro, beach, culture or a combination?

## 2. When can you go?

Check the season. See [weather by month](/blog/tanzania-weather-by-month/) and the [migration calendar](/blog/great-migration-month-by-month/).

## 3. How long?

See [how long should a safari be](/blog/how-long-safari-tanzania/).

## 4. Budget and style

Simple, comfortable or luxurious? This determines your lodges.

## 5. Ask for a proposal

Tell us your wishes. We put together a route with our partner. See [how a tailor-made trip works](/blog/how-a-tailor-made-trip-works/).

## 6. Book flights

Ideally arriving at Kilimanjaro and leaving from Zanzibar. See [flights](/blog/flights-to-tanzania/).

## 7. Arrange visa, vaccinations and insurance

See the [visa guide](/blog/tanzania-visa-guide/), [vaccinations](/blog/tanzania-vaccinations/) and [insurance](/blog/tanzania-travel-insurance/).

## 8. Pack

See [safari packing mistakes](/blog/safari-packing-mistakes/).

## 9. Final check

See the [travel checklist](/blog/tanzania-travel-checklist/).

[Start with step 5](/travel-proposal/).
